title: Explosive atmospheres and ATEX zones
prompt: You have 2 minutes to prepare (notes only, no full script) and 2-3 minutes to speak. Task: Explain to new contractors arriving at a chemical plant what an explosive atmosphere is, how ATEX zones are classified, and what rules they must follow inside them.

title: Foreign traveller with lost documents at the airport
prompt: Role-play. YOU: a Guardia Civil officer at the border control post of an international airport.
